definition: to take something off or out by lifting it
description: A woman in a white t-shirt bends down in a white kitchen and opens the oven door on a tray of golden muffins under the oven light. She reaches in and lifts the baking tray out, smiling at it. Cut to a man in a dark jumper in a wooden kitchen who opens the oven on a whole roast turkey and slides the roasting tin out towards himself. Finally a baker in a white coat and apron in a bakery draws a long wooden peel out of a deck oven and turns to the camera holding a board of six big fresh loaves.

taps.phrase: to remove a tray of muffins
to slide out a roasting tin
taps.target: the man in the dark jumper
